description: Found by the fz-go4.18.28.5 correctness audit (pre-existing, unchanged by that commit). jobs/transport.rs:1010-1022: the ?-early-return pattern on missing RuntimeDemand/activation_analysis/callsite_summary silently terminates the closure-membership while loop rather than emitting a wait for the missing fact. Currently masked by the caller always populating runtime_demands before re-entering the loop, but fragile if that invariant ever loosens — a silent partial walk is a conclude-by-omission analogue on the product side. TASK: make the absence explicit — either return the missing-fact wait (pull-shaped) or assert the caller invariant so a future loosening fails loudly instead of shrinking closures silently.
title: expand_transport_product_executables ?-early-return silently ends the walk instead of emitting a wait
